items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: My mother taught me practically everything I knew.

ctx.x: What's some of the first music you listened to? Did you learn any, you must have learned some religious music. Did your mother teach you any music? Yeah.
My mother taught me practically everything I knew. About all music? About music. Drum, piano, bass, guitar, dancing. Did you sing?
So your first contact with music was through your mother and it was? Through my mother, yeah. What kind of, spirituals or?
